title: Request Snapshot Card: compact debugging surface for failed requests
creator: Lina Chen
description: Design and prototype a compact 'Request Snapshot' card that surfaces the most actionable information for a failed request in the Console timeline and dashboards. The card should allow quick triage (error category, retry state, latency, model/route) and provide pathways to deeper tools (payload inspector, replay, full trace).
goals: Reduce mean time to triage for failed requests by surfacing a one-panel summary
Provide clear mapping between errors and remediation hints (user, infra, model mismatch)
Balance privacy with debuggability via redaction & lazy-loading of sensitive payloads
Make the card embeddable in Timeline rows, Rollout views, and Per-route dashboards
acceptance_criteria: Compact card shows status icon, error taxonomy label, short error message, retry count, latency, model + route
Expandable payload inspector loads only after user action and supports redaction toggles
Action buttons: Open full trace, Replay request (with editable prompt), Export HAR
Design has hi-fi Figma prototypes for desktop and tablet, and annotated handoff notes for engineering
PM and Eng reviews recorded and feedback addressed (see updates)
design_notes: Primary pattern: collapsed summary row that expands inline; avoids navigating away from current context
Error taxonomy badges (User / Model / Infra / RateLimit / Auth / Unknown) derived from infra mapping layer; show 'suggested next action' per badge
Privacy trade-off: do not auto-render full request body; show redacted preview and 'Reveal payload' action which requires consent and logs access
Performance trade-off: payload viewer is a heavy bundle (code viewer + token-highlighting). Implement lazy loading and a lightweight preview component for the collapsed state
Reuse existing Console components: StatusChip, RouteBadge, SmallMetric, CodeViewer; propose a new compact ActionBar for quick actions
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with product + eng. Agreed taxonomy buckets should align with runtime error codes (ENG to provide mapping).
2026-03-05: Low-fidelity sketches completed. Two flows: inline expand vs modal payload inspector. PM prefers inline for quick triage.
2026-03-07: Engineering flagged CodeViewer bundle size; decided to lazy-load and show token-sampled preview in collapsed state.
2026-03-09: Design review with Security. Security requested an explicit access log whenever raw payload is revealed; added redaction toggle and audit event requirement.
2026-03-10: Hi-fi prototypes posted to Figma. PR opened for the new ActionBar component (see attachments).
2026-03-12: UX review notes: reorder summary to show 'suggested next action' before metrics; PM requests show 'first seen' timestamp for new error types. Assigned follow-ups to update annotations.
review_feedback: PM (Asha Patel): prioritize showing retry history and automated fallback suggestions. Ensure concise copy for non-technical stakeholders.
Eng (Daniel Park): need clear mapping to runtime error codes and back-compat behavior when taxonomy changes. Also add telemetry event names for each action.
Security (Maya Brooks): require consent modal for revealing PII in payloads; add redaction heuristics and an allowlist for dev-access in Private deployments.
implementation_notes: Frontend: new RequestSnapshot React component with collapsed + expanded states; lazy import of CodeViewer and token-highlighting module
Backend: expose a single endpoint for redacted-preview and a separate endpoint for full payload gated by audit logging & RBAC
Telemetry: emit snapshot.view, snapshot.expand, payload.reveal, snapshot.replay events with request_id and user_id
Accessibility: ensure keyboard navigation for expand/collapse, labels for badges, and sufficient color contrast for status indicators
